cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, random, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
rng=random.Random(5200)
n=rng.choice([24,32,40,48]); print("n",n)
nl=min(128, rng.randint(n, 3*n)); print("nl",nl)
allp=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)); rng.shuffle(allp)
tree=[(i,i+1) for i in range(n-1)]
rest=[p for p in allp if p not in set(tree)]
pairs=(tree if rng.random()<0.8 else [])+rest[:max(0,nl-len(tree))]
links=[[u,v,rng.choice([1,2,3,5,8,20])] for (u,v) in pairs[:128]]
k=rng.randint(3,12); parts=sorted(rng.sample(range(n),k)); print("parts",parts)
per=rng.choice([100,300,1000]); print("per",per)
env=[[l,rng.choice([1,2,3])] for l in range(len(links))]
dem=[[v,rng.choice([0,1,2,3])] for v in parts]
if sum(d for _,d in dem)==0: dem[0][1]=1
print("dem",dem, "D",sum(d for _,d in dem))
print("zero-capacity links in env:", sum(1 for l,rr in env if links[l][2]==0))
import subprocess
cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":links,"bookings":[]},
      {"op":"prepare","id":"pa","owner":"o","window":[0,per*3],"period":per,"participants":dem,"envelope":env,"rev":0}]
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"],input="\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cmds)+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
print(out.stdout.splitlines()[-1][:400])
PYEOF
